pattern: SELECT .* FROM .* WHERE .* NOT IN \(SELECT .*\) AND (.* FROM .*)
correction: Select names of singers who do not have any songs associated with them in the database by using a subquery to find the IDs of all singers in the song table and then filtering out those singers whose IDs are not found in the singer table.

metadata.description: This rule corrects a SQL query that incorrectly uses a subquery to find rows in one table (singer) where the ID is not found in another table (song).
